mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNTS ( connection_id, account_number, account_display_number, account_name, account_type, account_subtype, balance, eval_amount, currency, status ) VALUES ( #{connectionId}, #{account.number}, #{account.displayNumber}, #{account.name}, #{account.type}, #{account.subtype}, #{account.balance}, #{account.evaluationAmount}, #{account.currency}, #{account.status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_display_number = VALUES(account_display_number), account_name = VALUES(account_name), account_type = VALUES(account_type), account_subtype = VALUES(account_subtype), balance = VALUES(balance), eval_amount = VALUES(eval_amount), currency = VALUES(currency), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM ACCOUNTS WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND account_number = #{accountNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CARDS (connection_id, card_number, card_name, card_type, status, valid_period) VALUES (#{connectionId}, #{card.number}, #{card.name}, #{card.type}, #{card.status}, #{card.validPeriod}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_name = VALUES(card_name), card_type = VALUES(card_type), status = VALUES(status), valid_period = VALUES(valid_period), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT card_id FROM CARDS WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND card_number = #{cardNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_SNAPSHOTS (user_id, snapshot_month, total_assets) VALUES (#{userId}, #{snapshot.month}, #{snapshot.totalAssets}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_assets = VALUES(total_assets), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO TRANSACTIONS ( user_id, card_id, account_id, type, category, amount, merchant_name, original_merchant_name, original_sector, external_approval_no, category_source, category_confidence, classifier_version, source_type, source_organization_code, source_transaction_id, source_dedup_key, transaction_date, transaction_time ) VALUES ( #{transaction.userId}, #{transaction.cardId}, #{transaction.accountId}, #{transaction.type}, #{transaction.category}, #{transaction.amount}, #{transaction.merchantName}, #{transaction.originalMerchantName}, #{transaction.originalSector}, #{transaction.approvalNo}, #{transaction.categorySource}, #{transaction.categoryConfidence}, #{transaction.classifierVersion}, #{transaction.sourceType}, #{transaction.sourceOrganizationCode}, #{transaction.sourceTransactionId}, #{transaction.sourceDedupKey}, #{transaction.date}, #{transaction.time} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_id = VALUES(card_id), account_id = VALUES(account_id), type = VALUES(type), category = CASE WHEN category_source = 'AI' AND #{transaction.categorySource} = 'FALLBACK' THEN category ELSE #{transaction.category} END, amount = VALUES(amount), merchant_name = VALUES(merchant_name), original_merchant_name = VALUES(original_merchant_name), original_sector = VALUES(original_sector), external_approval_no = VALUES(external_approval_no), category_source = CASE WHEN category_source = 'AI' AND #{transaction.categorySource} = 'FALLBACK' THEN category_source ELSE #{transaction.categorySource} END, category_confidence = CASE WHEN category_source = 'AI' AND #{transaction.categorySource} = 'FALLBACK' THEN category_confidence ELSE #{transaction.categoryConfidence} END, classifier_version = CASE WHEN category_source = 'AI' AND #{transaction.categorySource} = 'FALLBACK' THEN classifier_version ELSE #{transaction.classifierVersion} END, transaction_date = VALUES(transaction_date), transaction_time = VALUES(transaction_time)
mapper.select: SELECT transaction_id AS transactionId, amount AS amount, transaction_date AS date, transaction_time AS time, category AS category FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_type = 'BANK_TRANSACTION' AND ( ( type = 'TRANSFER' AND category IN ('SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND ( merchant_name LIKE '%체크%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%카드%' OR merchant_name LIKE '%가맹%' OR original_merchant_name LIKE '%체크%' OR original_merchant_name LIKE '%카드%' OR original_merchant_name LIKE '%가맹%' ) ) OR ( type = 'EXPENSE' AND category <> 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL' ) ) ORDER BY transaction_date, transaction_time, transaction_id

SELECT card_transaction.transaction_id AS transactionId, card_transaction.amount AS amount, card_transaction.transaction_date AS date, card_transaction.transaction_time AS time, card_transaction.category AS category FROM TRANSACTIONS card_transaction INNER JOIN CARDS card ON card.card_id = card_transaction.card_id WHERE card_transaction.user_id = #{userId} AND card_transaction.source_type = 'CARD_APPROVAL' AND card_transaction.type = 'EXPENSE' AND UPPER(card.card_type) IN ('CHECK', 'DEBIT', '1') ORDER BY card_transaction.transaction_date, card_transaction.transaction_time, card_transaction.transaction_id
mapper.update: UPDATE TRANSACTIONS SET category = #{category}, category_source = CASE WHEN #{category} = 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL' THEN 'CARD_RECONCILIATION' ELSE 'BANK_DIRECTION' END, category_confidence = 1.0000, classifier_version = CASE WHEN #{category} = 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL' THEN 'card-bank-match-v1' ELSE 'bank-direction-v1' END WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND source_type = 'BANK_TRANSACTION' AND type IN ('TRANSFER', 'EXPENSE')
